items.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: a friend of mine from Maine, Don Doane wound up driving the other one

ctx.x: What was the travel situation like, the road? Was it a tough grind in those days?

Yes. Looking back at it you forget all those things. But — it was a wonderful experience but I wouldn’t want to do it again. Yeah, because we had — we didn’t have a bus, we had station wagons. And starting salary on that band was $120 a week. I made $135 because I was not only the lead alto player but played a lot of jazz toodon and because he’d known me. And so $135 a week and he had two station wagons and then he drove himself, he had two jaguars — a Mark IX that never ran more than three or four blocks at a…
Yeah. Gee that was like an extra night of work.
